prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity native Windows Flutter app composition, option A for Wabbit TV My Library
Primary request: Design the complete first viewport of the Wabbit TV "My Library" destination at exactly a 1265 by 713 landscape window. This is an Operate surface, not marketing.
Input images: use the three referenced Wabbit TV approved comps only as visual-system references for Quiet Broadcast palette, Windows title frame, collapsed left navigation rail, typography, compact geometry, line weights, and amber focus. Do not copy their content.
Structure in exact order: native black Windows title bar with small Wabbit TV name; collapsed 72px rail with seven monochrome destination icons and My Library selected; content header "My Library" with quiet subtitle "Your saved library"; below, a 270px left directory and a dominant right mixed-item ledger.
Option A topology: left directory is labeled "Library" and lists "Favorites" selected with count 12, then "Living Room", "Weekend Movies", "News & Sports", and "Kids" with small counts. Right header says "Favorites" and "12 items". The ledger is dense with eight 64px rows, each row one focus target with a fixed 50x36 provider-art thumbnail, real-looking but explicitly synthetic titles, a small LIVE/MOVIE/SERIES label, and quiet source provenance. One row has a precise 2px amber focus edge. No create/edit/add/remove buttons in this Phase 3 read-only surface.
Style/medium: flat matte product UI mockup, crisp Segoe UI-like typography, graphite #111212, raised #222321, warm white, quiet gray, signal amber #FFB347, compact 6-8px corners, 1px separators, no pills.
Composition/framing: straight-on full-window screenshot, 1265x713 landscape, all edges visible, balanced television-distance readability.
Constraints: exact visible text must be spelled correctly; titles and art are synthetic compositional evidence. Preserve dense directory-not-storefront presentation. No poster grid, hero, recommendations, promotional copy, gradients, glass, neon glow, ambient shadows, floating cards, rabbit illustration, provider logos, credentials, URLs, badges beyond media kind, or mobile layout.
